title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 16: Jerusalem told of her origin, the care and ornaments given to her, her sisters, and the everlasting covenant.

questions.text: What was the son of man to cause Jerusalem to know?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told him to cause Jerusalem to know her abominations.

questions.text: Who are named as her father and her mother?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says to Jerusalem that an Amorite was her father and her mother was a Hittite.

answers.text: A Hittite father and an Amorite mother
A Philistine father and an Assyrian mother
An Amorite father and a Hittite mother
An Egyptian father and a Chaldean mother

questions.text: What does the chapter say about the day she was born?
questions.explanation: In the day she was born her navel was not cut, she was not washed in water, not salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets.

answers.text: She was wrapped in blankets and washed
Her navel was not cut and she was not washed
She was carried into a city

questions.text: What did Yahweh say when he passed by and saw her?
questions.explanation: He said to her, 'Though you are in your blood, live!' and said it a second time.

answers.text: Fear not, for I am with you
You are the work of my hands
Though you are in your blood, live!

questions.text: What did Yahweh put on her head?
questions.explanation: He put a ring on her nose, earrings in her ears, and a beautiful crown on her head.

questions.text: Why did her renown go out among the nations?
questions.explanation: Her renown went out among the nations for her beauty, for it was perfect through the majesty Yahweh had put on her.

questions.text: What proverb would everyone use against her?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against her: 'As is the mother, so is her daughter.'

answers.text: The fathers have eaten sour grapes
The days are prolonged, and every vision fails
As is the mother, so is her daughter

questions.text: Who is called her elder sister?
questions.explanation: Her elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at her left hand, and her younger sister is Sodom, who dwells at her right hand.

questions.text: What does verse 49 name as the iniquity of her sister Sodom?
questions.explanation: The iniquity of Sodom was pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease, and she did not strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

answers.text: Theft, murder and robbery of the poor
Pride, fullness of bread and prosperous ease
Breaking the Sabbath and swearing oaths

questions.text: What does Yahweh say at the end of the chapter that he will establish with her?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will remember his covenant with her from the days of her youth and establish to her an everlasting covenant.

answers.text: A new city on the mountain
